Diwali/ Laxmi Puja bank holiday: Are banks open or closed today on November 9, 2026?
 By Sneha Kulkarni , ET Online Last Updated: Nov 09, 2026, 07:00:00 AM IST Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis
 Bank branches will close in certain states on November 9, 2026, for Diwali and related festivities. Customers should verify bank operating hours in their regions before planning any bank visits. Celebrations including Diwali/Laxmi Puja will lead to closures in several states like Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh. Other states and union territories will maintain regular operations on this day. ET Online ​Are banks open or closed in your state today? ​ Diwali and Laxmi Puja celebrations will impact banking operations in several parts of the country today (Monday, November 9, 2026). Customers planning to visit bank branches for cash deposits, withdrawals, cheque-related work or other services should check whether banks are open in their city before stepping out.
Banks will remain closed in select states on Monday to observe Diwali/Laxmi Puja (Deepawali), Govardhan Pooja and Vishwakarma Day. Since the holiday does not apply uniformly across India, branch closures will depend on the state.
 November 2026 bank holiday occasions
Diwali/Laxmi Puj/Govardhan Pooja/Vishwakarma Day, Diwali (Bali Pratipada)/Deepawali (Govardhan Puja)/Laxmi Puja/Vikram Samvant New Year Day, Laxmi Puja (Deepawali)/Ningol Chakkouba/Bhratridwitiya/Bhaidooj/Chitragupt Jayanti, Wangala Festival, Chhath Puja/Surya Shashti Dala Chhath (Prath Arghya), Igas-Bagwal, Seng Kut Snem, Guru Nanak Jayanti/Karthika Purnima/ Rahas Purnima and Kanakadasa Jayanthi. 
 Bank holiday on November 9, 2026 in these states
Banks will be closed on November 9, 2026, to celebrate Diwali/Laxmi Puja (Deepawali)/Govardhan Pooja/Vishwakarma Day in Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Tripura, Chandigarh, Sikkim and Manipur.
Banks will work as a regular working day in all other states and union territories (UTs).
